label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf) alert-TP: resolved sink value is https://<USER_INPUT>/health. User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly into 'name', which is used in the URL construction at line 29. Although InetAddress.getByName() resolves the hostname and isNonPublicAddress() validates the resolved IP, the URL is still constructed with the original user-controlled hostname string. Attackers can exploit DNS rebinding attacks where a domain resolves to a public IP during validation but redirects to internal IPs later. The sink value depends on attacker input on the executed path.

evidence.note: User input param flows to name, then used in URL construction at line 29: new java.net.URL("https://" + name + "/health").openStream()
